scope: One already-performed shadow restart followed by steady, physically unchanged Samsung observations. This is not evidence for plug, unplug, suspend/resume, broken-EDID, AOC, or restart-in-pending-action scenarios.

audit.state_key_chain: Every decision retains production audit.prior_state_key and audit.resulting_state_key; each decision's resulting key equals the next decision's prior key across the bounded source order (the intervening would_dispatch annotation has no state transition).

redaction.input: UTF-8 LF-delimited production audit records in the inclusive source line bounds above
deterministic_algorithm: Parse each selected source line as one JSON object and retain its source line number plus SHA-256 of the complete source line including LF.
Retain header, decision, and would_dispatch record semantics. Retain complete decision audit metadata, event/effect payloads, and would_dispatch payloads.
Project state objects onto the field whitelist documented in fixtures/traces/README.md; project latest_observation with all production canonical-observation fields.

For every live_fingerprints item, decode its lowercase even-length hexadecimal value to bytes, replace value with value_redaction={sha256: SHA-256(decoded bytes), bytes: len(decoded bytes)}, and retain output unchanged.

Serialize every projected object with sorted keys, ASCII JSON, no insignificant whitespace, and one trailing LF. No timestamps, IDs, state keys, timings, wake reasons, effects, profiles, connector mappings, raw-evidence hashes, or non-EDID values are rewritten.

service_evidence.query: systemctl --user show UNIT -p ActiveState -p SubState -p MainPID -p NRestarts -p ExecMainStartTimestamp

zero_side_effect_evidence.unit_query_stdout: monitor-controller-shadow.service loaded active running Non-authoritative monitor controller shadow

xrandr_query.after_source: command:xrandr --query raw_evidence reference on every valid observation in the bounded production audit
